# `kaolin/metrics/VolumetricIoU.js`

> **Source:** `engine/kaolin/metrics/VolumetricIoU.js`

VolumetricIoU.js — Intersection over Union for 3D shapes Measures overlap between two 3D shapes by voxelizing both and computing |intersection| / |union|. Also supports direct voxel grid inputs (skip re-voxelization). Used by: agi/ training loops, mesh reconstruction quality, shape matching.

## Functions

### `volumetricIoU(positionsA, indicesA, positionsB, indicesB, options = {})`

Compute Volumetric IoU between two triangle meshes. Voxelizes both at the same resolution/origin, then counts overlap.

**Parameters:**

- `positionsA` *(Float32Array)* — — stride 3
- `indicesA` *(Uint32Array)* — — stride 3
- `positionsB` *(Float32Array)* — — stride 3
- `indicesB` *(Uint32Array)* — — stride 3
- `options` *(Object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `options.resolution` *(number)* — — voxels per longest axis (default 32)
- `options.fillInterior` *(boolean)* — — fill interiors before comparing (default true)

**Returns:** }

### `voxelGridIoU(gridA, gridB)`

Compute IoU directly from two voxel grids (same dimensions).

**Parameters:**

- `gridA` *(Uint8Array)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `gridB` *(Uint8Array)* — _No description in source JSDoc._

**Returns:** }

### `fScore(pointsPred, pointsGT, threshold)`

F-Score: harmonic mean of precision and recall at a distance threshold. Precision = fraction of predicted points within threshold of ground truth. Recall = fraction of ground truth points within threshold of prediction.

**Parameters:**

- `pointsPred` *(Float32Array)* — — stride 3
- `pointsGT` *(Float32Array)* — — stride 3
- `threshold` *(number)* — — distance threshold

**Returns:** }
